title: aprender-train-inspect validate prints PASS and exits 0 on an empty or garbage file
evidence: measured 2026-09-26 (aprender-01) on the 0.69.3 build from batch/ont-10: `validate garbage.bin` -> 'Validation Result: PASS' with checks 'Safe format' and 'Valid file size' both ✗, exit 0; same for an empty file. crates/aprender-train-inspect/src/validate.rs: IntegrityChecker reads no content (extension in {safetensors,gguf,apr} + size > 1000); non-strict makes V002 a warning and the size check only a warning, and valid = no Error issues. 2000 zero bytes named .gguf pass.
ask: validate must parse the header of the format it claims (safetensors/gguf/apr) and exit non-zero when it cannot; then add the empty/garbage rows to unusable_input_is_rejected in crates/aprender-train-inspect/tests/cli_surface_gate.rs (they are deliberately not asserted today).

title: aprender-train-lora inspect reads no adapter content and exits 0 on an empty or garbage file
